title: whtdragon's tileset s addons, fixes and more!

posts.author: whtdragon
posts.body:
So I've been debating on doing this for awhile, and I'm still not quite sure how to organize this stuff out, so bare with me while I get things straightened out, but basically I've been working on tilesets for awhile in between animal sprites and other stuff, just kind of looming in the backdrop for when I felt like I had enough satisfying things to present.
I debated HEAVILY about putting all this in the
festivals and celebrations thread
but I decided against that because I feel like the focus of this is different from that, and I wanted to keep the festivals and celebrations thread it's own fun lil' thing to update.
I'm starting to notice a lot of creative folks working on plugins and sprites for a wide variety of things, and I figure I might as well post some things I feel like folks would logically need next. Some of this stuff is stuff I felt like NEEDED to be added because I'm not satisfied with the small amount of tiles to work with in the defaults, and I'm sure a lot of folks feel the same way. Like almost everything else I do, these are sticking closely to the MV default style, so a lot of it's gonna be recolors, but I will also try and cover some tile fixes and extra filler stuff that have been bugging me since MV was released (and I know some people have pointed them out too)  Also if I messed up on anything lemme know and I'll get 'em fixed. I've been working on a ton of this stuff lately, and yes I do have more, coming soon.
Terms:
As these are (mostly) edits of MV's sprites, you will need a legal copy of RPG maker MV
,
otherwise~~
Credit is appreciated, but not required.
They are free to use for commercial or non commercial.
You are free to use them in other RPG maker engines as long as you have MV license
You are free to edit, change, recolor, re-edit, remix, maim, mangle, add on, divide, and conquer to your heart's content. I don't even mind if you re-upload them elsewhere as it would only mean more people get access to them and that is A-OK in my books.
Tile Fixes:
First one I'd like to bring up that I fixed was the thing involving the lava tiles. (I'm sure someone else has done this too, but I can't find any threads specifically on the subject)
this is now a thing. Two animated waterfall (lavaflow rather) are required for this fix. one for top, one for bottom. You may find my full new Lava themed A1 tileset with the fix
here
or in the spoiler below assuming those still work properly.
Spoiler
Vines:
As there is currently only three types of vines, and vines are extremely common and used constantly in almost everyone's games, I have made a whole bunch of vine edits to break up the monotony
Spoiler
autotiles:
Sometimes things do not have auto-tiles that should, and that makes me a sad dragon. Like leaves. so I did that. More below.
expansions:
The "Demon World" tiles got a much needed expansion as well as some of the lesser used tiles. I still want to make more for it sometime, but hopefully what I do have now might be useful to someone. I am working on more.
side stairs:
gotten some requests to do some sideview staircases, so I took the small default ones from MV, and made them much larger, then added ones for grass, sand dirt, wood and stone. I know there's been several that's already done this, but I also included more of my recolored grasses and volcanic rock. I also included a "base" version so anyone can easily edit.
Spoiler
Volcano and cave tiles:
I know there's already a lot of resources for caverns and volcano themed tiles already but I did try to hit on the ones everyone seems to avoid. I also made several new more natural tones as well as a lot of varieties for mixed color sets. not only did I make a lot of new lava crack tiles for the various varieties of colors, but I've also got "cooled lava" where the lava has cooled down and is now black, and of course, I have also taken the liberty of adding some of the new lava flow animations with the fix, and I made a few "Abyss" type tiles.
Spoiler
massive wall/floor tiles. Note this is NOT a tileset. You will need to edit them into your own tilesets for use.
"Abyss" tiles and some extra stairs, wall holes. Note there are two lava autotiles. You will also need to edit these into your tilesets for use. I almost added crystals to the other walls too, but mmm I got kind of lazy /- w -; and it'd mean having to make new curved walls for everything and I'll do that maybe later.
This is a tileset B for new volcano/caves. I admit it's a bit messy. I've added a ton of new rock formations, and some new rock pillars, and I hope folks will get to use them/edit them~ There is a rock themed bed, chair/throne, counter and shelf with books because, well I wanted to make those. There is one issue with the stone tiles. I kind of made them blend in a bit TOO well with the ground tiles I have there, so if you do use them together I HIGHLY suggest you use more then one ground type to kind of patch it along so they stand out better, or edit their colors slightly so they stand out a bit better otherwise I'm sure plenty of people will enjoy them. also new flooded staircases o w o~
limestone/white submerged water caverns: will likely add more to this one later~
Statues:
Just an assortment of different kinds of statues
Spoiler
Monster statues:
Maiden Statues
Seabed/underwater and ocean/beach tiles
:
this is the one I've been holding back the longest and it's been driving me crazy because I kept adding onto it, unsatisfied with it. I'm still not really happy with the set, but I'm hoping other folks are going to use it and play around with it and I know it's going to be massively useful. Includes many different colorful types of coral with some basic ocean colored tiles for ruins. Nothing too fancy there. The Ocean tiles are mimicing how XP handled some of the water tiles, I just really liked the tiles layering so I matched it as best I could. Added new ocean tiles!
Spoiler
a few basic seabed colored floors/walls with some extra stone pillars. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it.
full array of a B tileset, though you will likely end up having to edit it to fit your needs. (especially since there's some ground tiles not ment to be put in there oops :x ) still includes lots of coral and seaweed types! Also hope you like colors 'cause that's what we got.
Extra beach and ocean layers. It is a full A1 tilset. Not all of these really matches each other too well. Some of these would PROBABLY be better suited in the over world, but I figure for what it's worth it'll probably work for either over world and normal maps. added new overworld waterfall types because I can o w o~
new water tiles! Includes new variants of blue and a few more crazy/alien colors. These also have the seashore line without any sand, this is for better customization if anyone is interested in doing that. can be paired with some of ground and sand recolors.
Spiderwebs on stuff
:
currently only have spiderwebs for indoors. I am working on an outdoors version and eventually a cavern and forest version. This includes most major items having some kind of cob webbing on them, and I'm talking big gnarly spiderwebs. Includes MANY many wall, ceiling and floor webs, as well as most of the shelves, tables, cabinets, and chairs found in the defaults as well as a very basic web bridge. Not all the items from the default have been webbed, but I had an abandoned house in mind and figured most of the valuables and food would have been long gone. Outside spider web tiles are now included!
Spoiler
lil' preview of the webs in game. As you can see, the webbing is very gnarly, almost over the top. Perfect for spider monsters or cinematics.
This is a nearly full B tileset. The main issue with this one is it's not really easy to see the webbings so you might find yourself having to redo placements on them. Most webbing does have some kind of shadow though to make it a little easier to find. The reasoning for two different pianos and organs is I liked them both without as much webbing but the more I worked with the spider webs, the more they felt out of place from everything else so I made a second set that had more. Added more statues and boxes/crates
outside tiles full of spiderwebs o w o/~ this IS a nearly completed B tileset. I might add on to later down the line. It is ment to be an extension of the base outside tiles but could also be used with the indoor webbings for extended web use. Added new damaged windows too and an extended sign post.
Demon world tiles and other dark tiles
:
The tilesets that no one asked for lol when I opened up MV for the first time, and was looking around at the various tiles I was very much not happy that there was so few assets and items for other tiles that wasn't your typical fare of forests and villages. Here I have given the demon world tiles a whole new set of ground and wall types. Most of which are recolors. When I was working with the tileset, I had in mind an almost beautiful alien world where the various monsters originated from. Really there isn't as much here as I would probably like, but I did basically triple the amount of resources for the demon world, and hope it at least gives people insenstives to maybe take a second look at one of the more overlooked sets in RPG maker, and maybe make more content for it. The other tileset of course is the inner body one. I didn't make a lot of extras for it either, but I wasn't satisfied with what little was in the defaults, so I did some expanding on it and hopefully it's a bit more satisfying to use.
Spoiler
another look at the demon world tiles using more default items:
As you can see, this is a far larger expansion for something that should be in game content. I added a bunch of new ground covers in various recolors. It's not as expansive as the volcano tiles I made by any means, and is lacking a few things I would personally want, but it does have the basics. A decent ground tile, a stone pathway that could lead up to the castle for example, many new recolors for native plants, and some decent water tiles. As mentioned above I wanted this to be almost a beautiful strange world, the idea would be that it contrasts to the far more terrifying things found in the castle. Of course alternatively it could be used for scifi settings in alien planets. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
Here are some demon castle recolors and a few expansions. I came like, super close to making a whole new set of furniture just for this but went against it because I wasn't quite sure where to start for that. One of the things I wanted to do was expand on the eyeball floor coverings the default had. I twas the first thing I edited before deciding on going ahead and editing more of the demon world. The default was implying some kind of carpet that was leading up to the final boss. I made it more like a creepy normal floor tile with added eyeballs and even animated them. Yep~ the eyeballs are an A1 based tile and they animate. not very well mind you, A1 tiles are limited and the animation is a bit lame as a result but what can ya do~ Most of this is simple recolors, just adding more variety to the castles. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
I won't spend too much talking about this tileset, because I imagine of all the tilesets, this is the most likeliest one no one would ask more of, and now no one will ever have to. It is of course the inner body tilesets in all it's grossness. I was a little disappointed it didn't have any kind of liquid tiles that XP's defaults had, and of course I made those, both the XP's original yellow acid looking stuff, and a recolor of red blood stuff. I went through MANY many different variants of colors and tilesets trying to get this one to work with more colors, but it was just not working. Almost everything I tried would end up like a muggy mess, and well I didn't really want to spend THAT much more time messing with these. It IS kind of gross lol. I did recolor some of the demon world tiles to match it better since they all look like something that could work within it. I also added new pillers and more structures just to give some variants. The one major issue I have with this tileset is the water doesn't seem to animate too well. If someone REALLY wants me to change that, I will otherwise it's not really too big an issue.

Winterized full tilesets:
I decided to take some of the default MV tilesets and make them winterized. So far, it is only the two modern (SF_outsideB and SF_outsideC) tiles and Outside B. The desert tiles have snow on them, and I DID go ahead and make snow versions of things that already had some snow types to them for a couple of reasons. 1, so the tiles would match to all the others I made, and 2. so there would be more variants. I do have some other tiles that I'll probably be making winter themed eventually!
Spoiler

SF_Outside B winterized
SF_outside C winterized
Graveyard and Catacombs:
I posted this one up a little while ago on twitter and on my profile. Since I have a lot of tiles to showcase I can show this one off too! It's pretty basic, the first half is for the outside/graveyard portion, and the right side is ment for some of the inner tiles, but it'll also work well with some outer components. I will be making some more dedicated inner tiles for this eventually, but for now this is pretty okay I think! It's loosely based off of The Zelda series for graveyards where the graves could hide hidden passageways. I also felt like there needed to be more varieties in headstones as well. The dead trees I don't know if they look okay or not, may have to rework those.
Spoiler
Desert Tiles:
This is a tileset that's been kicking around in my folders for awhile and a "lite" version compared to some of the others I've made- well as far as the tileset A goes. The rest is pretty custom. The tileset A is a full complete tileset, the other one you will have to do some light editing on, as there's two wall tiles there that needs to go into a wall autotile set. The Desert Tileset A is nothing particularly interesting, just gives some desert tiling and puts sand on a few of the tiles to make it more dynamic.
The titleset includes some Egyptian themed statues and a basic Pyramid that you could build out into quite a large set piece. This is ment for exploring ruins, and not really set for a full Egyptian themed set.
Spoiler
Desert Tileset A

Grass,Dirt, flowerbeds, and leaves recolors

Because no one is recoloring this stuff, and I think we need to.
Not only am I covering recolored grasses and dirts, I'm also going to release a lot of flowerbed type stuff. This also includes auto-tiles for leaves and some other stuff I feel like needs to be done.
Spoiler

more grass types of various colors
AND SINCE WE'RE RECOLORING GRASS AND DIRT
here's some simple more recolored dirt, sand and ground types:
additional/recolored leaves that are in fact auto tiles. This is the one that bothered me a lot because it should have been a thing right off the bat and it wasn't. Can be used for weddings for makeshift flower peddles too!
new leaves recolors!
Autotile Flowerbeds, I posted this earlier elsewhere but here's the official upload.
non auto-tiled flowerbeds in case you wanted something more customizable. Comes with dirt with boarders, more or less a sized up version of the default garden dirt but resized. Can also be used for trees and other plants. Also added extra dirt and some more boarders in case anyone wants those too u w o;
Buildings and inner items:
I told myself I wouldn't do any building based edits because there's already a ton of those available by lots of people, but I went ahead and did some editings myself. None of these are tilesets, they WILL need to be edited and added in as needed. Walls, Windows, Chairs and Rugs are here for now.
Now with extended shelves/store shelves, added kitchen items, TONS of colorful furniture, new furniture items, and new beds both side view and front, small and large and damaged in many colors!
Spoiler
Building/walls-- basically just expanded the color variants by a lot. Black and white variants are also available but moreso for chard/burnt colors. There are some darker toned colors for those that want a more natural/darker toned set. I also included a few multi-colored brick walls and some multi-colored rooftop tiles closer to the bottom u w o;~ yay colors! There's also some lighting tiles now for the windows.
massive castle recolors~
alternative wood rooftops with recolors with lighted windows--came really close to adding darker/night colors with them. maybe another time~
Even more rooftop recolors!
Window recolors are generally more natural wood colors. with a few painted ones. I didn't go too crazy with these in colors mostly because I wanted something that would pretty much go with anything else. I've seen lots of people do door recolors but I don't see too many recolors for the windows, so there ya go. There's a few darker toned browns at the bottom for darker tilesets.
Massive new rooftop extensions, there's so many I opted to give a
download instead right here
but here's a small sample:
requested lighting for windows, both for the defaults and all my recolors~ these are NOT a full tileset, you will need to edit them into your tiles
modern windows getting lighting:
Even MORE window lighting! this time for the castle tiles, tents, and other window types:
General purpose lighting for a variety of things.
I posted an early preview of these chairs up a week ago but I've since added more colors. I didn't like the original royal chair in the default tilesets so I've decided to make smaller varients to it. You can see the size difference up in the upper left corner. I decided to leave a lot of my edited trimmings so anyone can make more color variants if they so wish because I realize that that there could potentially be thousands of combinations for everyone, and I just wanted to make it as easy and painless as possible. I also decided to make other chair types because sometimes you just don't need a super fancy embellished chair. looking back on it I probably should make side and back versions of the other chairs because they do look like fancy dinning seats at least, but I might do that later down the line if there's enough interest for them.
I made these rug recolors awhile ago and posted them up on twitter, but I thought I'd post them up once I started getting into doing housing type tiles, and here we are. There are some edited rugs too, and I hope you enjoy u w u/
new modern rug/floor tiles:
made these awhile back --forgot to upload them! here they are!
modern wall tiles:
another set of tiles I didn't upload sooner. Here they are!
Nearly complete Tileset for new store shelves to extend shops, includes new variants for bakery, new baked goods, bottles on shelves, more kitchen shelves for restaurants or a massive kitchen, larger extended stove expanded kitchen counter for new shapes. New toy shop, flower shop, medicine shop, and jewelry store items, and expandable bookshelves for libraries or large rooms!
Massive recolors of various furniture with some smaller added furniture bits to help fill out rooms more. Comes in a variety of colors. I tried making it so everything would match with each other so you can color coordinate things better and they can at least look like they are somewhat matching with each other. If you notice, some of the modern tiles are now more closer to the other shelves in terms of colors so they don't clash so much being used together. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit what you want from it.
Extended beds, for both small and large sizes, side view, and damaged variants. Beds needed recoloring and that is what I set out to do. Comes in a variety of colors, I almost added in beds with patterned quilts to them but I decided against it for now-- this is really just being able to get these out there for general use. I'll probably add new patterns to the sheets later.
Dungeon Tiles:
I might as well make a new catagory since this will be a thing soon! Will be featuring all sorts of dungeon based tiles hopefully. The Treasure Room is currently available.
Spoiler
Treasure Room: I've been meaning to finish this one up for awhile now, but I wasn't sure how much more I could add to it. This IS a nearly complete tileset. No editing required, and I'll be trying to do that when it comes to these dungeon tiles if I can.
Extended Gold resources: This isn't technically part of the treasure room, but there's enough overlap it can be used. There's three major parts of this. First, Autotiles on the left side. Below the autotiles is a bunch of gold that's half submerged in water. They are half transparent so they should work with most water types. The second part, on the upper right side is cavern tiles and the third below that is gold walls with some matching furniture.
Raw files, resources,editables, and other misc. stuff:
These are NOT for use in game. These are 100% purely for editing purposes to change, edit, addon, remove and recolor. Currently only seabed stuff is in here because given how little there is to work with as far as underwater goes, I felt I should at least offer these up for anyone that wants to build off them.

's post could have been worded better, it unfortunately contains more than a few grains of truth.
Everyone here on the forum helps in their free time for free, often instead of working on their own projects. Because of this, we can't simply make a game for some one else, the time we have to help others is limited. And we prefer to spent that time on problems that really block other people.
If your time description is not an exaggeration and you really spent hours trying to get the tiles right, then most likely you're using the wrong tools. Because with the correct setup, it takes less than a minute to transfer a tile between different tilesheets.
The key to that is the "snap to grid" functions in all better image programs.
After loading any tilesheet, you need to set the grid of the program to the tilesize - for example 48*48 Pixels for MV - and then activate the "snap to grid" option.
If you do that, every time you mark something to copy the selection tools will automatically follow the tile border. And if you do the same on the target tilesheet, that copied tile will also be automatically aligned correctly. That way it usually takes only second to copy tiles correctly.
Trying to copy tiles freehand is a tiring and almost impossible mess however, so don't ever do that...
The same procedures apply to animated tiles, just a bit more complex. You need to use a different grid and keep in mind that the three animated frames are displayed in order 1-2-3-2-1-2-3.
If you need more help with that, please ask how to best do that in a new topic, because it will take a bit more explanations.

So I've been debating on doing this for awhile, and I'm still not quite sure how to organize this stuff out, so bare with me while I get things straightened out, but basically I've been working on tilesets for awhile in between animal sprites and other stuff, just kind of looming in the backdrop for when I felt like I had enough satisfying things to present.
I debated HEAVILY about putting all this in the
festivals and celebrations thread
but I decided against that because I feel like the focus of this is different from that, and I wanted to keep the festivals and celebrations thread it's own fun lil' thing to update.
I'm starting to notice a lot of creative folks working on plugins and sprites for a wide variety of things, and I figure I might as well post some things I feel like folks would logically need next. Some of this stuff is stuff I felt like NEEDED to be added because I'm not satisfied with the small amount of tiles to work with in the defaults, and I'm sure a lot of folks feel the same way. Like almost everything else I do, these are sticking closely to the MV default style, so a lot of it's gonna be recolors, but I will also try and cover some tile fixes and extra filler stuff that have been bugging me since MV was released (and I know some people have pointed them out too)  Also if I messed up on anything lemme know and I'll get 'em fixed. I've been working on a ton of this stuff lately, and yes I do have more, coming soon.
Terms:
As these are (mostly) edits of MV's sprites, you will need a legal copy of RPG maker MV
,
otherwise~~
Credit is appreciated, but not required.
They are free to use for commercial or non commercial.
You are free to use them in other RPG maker engines as long as you have MV license
You are free to edit, change, recolor, re-edit, remix, maim, mangle, add on, divide, and conquer to your heart's content. I don't even mind if you re-upload them elsewhere as it would only mean more people get access to them and that is A-OK in my books.
Tile Fixes:
First one I'd like to bring up that I fixed was the thing involving the lava tiles. (I'm sure someone else has done this too, but I can't find any threads specifically on the subject)

here

Spoiler
autotiles:
Sometimes things do not have auto-tiles that should, and that makes me a sad dragon. Like leaves. so I did that. More below.
expansions:
The "Demon World" tiles got a much needed expansion as well as some of the lesser used tiles. I still want to make more for it sometime, but hopefully what I do have now might be useful to someone. I am working on more.
side stairs:
gotten some requests to do some sideview staircases, so I took the small default ones from MV, and made them much larger, then added ones for grass, sand dirt, wood and stone. I know there's been several that's already done this, but I also included more of my recolored grasses and volcanic rock. I also included a "base" version so anyone can easily edit.
Spoiler
Volcano and cave tiles:
I know there's already a lot of resources for caverns and volcano themed tiles already but I did try to hit on the ones everyone seems to avoid. I also made several new more natural tones as well as a lot of varieties for mixed color sets. not only did I make a lot of new lava crack tiles for the various varieties of colors, but I've also got "cooled lava" where the lava has cooled down and is now black, and of course, I have also taken the liberty of adding some of the new lava flow animations with the fix, and I made a few "Abyss" type tiles.
Spoiler
massive wall/floor tiles. Note this is NOT a tileset. You will need to edit them into your own tilesets for use.
"Abyss" tiles and some extra stairs, wall holes. Note there are two lava autotiles. You will also need to edit these into your tilesets for use. I almost added crystals to the other walls too, but mmm I got kind of lazy /- w -; and it'd mean having to make new curved walls for everything and I'll do that maybe later.
This is a tileset B for new volcano/caves. I admit it's a bit messy. I've added a ton of new rock formations, and some new rock pillars, and I hope folks will get to use them/edit them~ There is a rock themed bed, chair/throne, counter and shelf with books because, well I wanted to make those. There is one issue with the stone tiles. I kind of made them blend in a bit TOO well with the ground tiles I have there, so if you do use them together I HIGHLY suggest you use more then one ground type to kind of patch it along so they stand out better, or edit their colors slightly so they stand out a bit better otherwise I'm sure plenty of people will enjoy them. also new flooded staircases o w o~
limestone/white submerged water caverns: will likely add more to this one later~
Seabed/underwater and ocean/beach tiles
:
this is the one I've been holding back the longest and it's been driving me crazy because I kept adding onto it, unsatisfied with it. full array of a B tileset, though you will likely end up having to edit it to fit your needs. (especially since there's some ground tiles not ment to be put in there oops :x ) still includes lots of coral and seaweed types! Also hope you like colors 'cause that's what we got.

:
currently only have spiderwebs for indoors. I am working on an outdoors version and eventually a cavern and forest version. This includes most major items having some kind of cob webbing on them, and I'm talking big gnarly spiderwebs. Includes MANY many wall, ceiling and floor webs, as well as most of the shelves, tables, cabinets, and chairs found in the defaults as well as a very basic web bridge. Not all the items from the default have been webbed, but I had an abandoned house in mind and figured most of the valuables and food would have been long gone. Outside spider web tiles are now included!
Spoiler

Demon world tiles and other dark tiles

The tilesets that no one asked for lol when I opened up MV for the first time, and was looking around at the various tiles I was very much not happy that there was so few assets and items for other tiles that wasn't your typical fare of forests and villages. Here I have given the demon world tiles a whole new set of ground and wall types. Most of which are recolors. When I was working with the tileset, I had in mind an almost beautiful alien world where the various monsters originated from. Really there isn't as much here as I would probably like, but I did basically triple the amount of resources for the demon world, and hope it at least gives people insenstives to maybe take a second look at one of the more overlooked sets in RPG maker, and maybe make more content for it. The other tileset of course is the inner body one. I didn't make a lot of extras for it either, but I wasn't satisfied with what little was in the defaults, so I did some expanding on it and hopefully it's a bit more satisfying to use.
Spoiler
another look at the demon world tiles using more default items:

It's not as expansive as the volcano tiles I made by any means, and is lacking a few things I would personally want, but it does have the basics. A decent ground tile, a stone pathway that could lead up to the castle for example, many new recolors for native plants, and some decent water tiles. As mentioned above I wanted this to be almost a beautiful strange world, the idea would be that it contrasts to the far more terrifying things found in the castle. Of course alternatively it could be used for scifi settings in alien planets. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
Here are some demon castle recolors and a few expansions. I came like, super close to making a whole new set of furniture just for this but went against it because I wasn't quite sure where to start for that. One of the things I wanted to do was expand on the eyeball floor coverings the default had. I twas the first thing I edited before deciding on going ahead and editing more of the demon world. The default was implying some kind of carpet that was leading up to the final boss. I made it more like a creepy normal floor tile with added eyeballs and even animated them. Yep~ the eyeballs are an A1 based tile and they animate. not very well mind you, A1 tiles are limited and the animation is a bit lame as a result but what can ya do~ Most of this is simple recolors, just adding more variety to the castles. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
I won't spend too much talking about this tileset, because I imagine of all the tilesets, this is the most likeliest one no one would ask more of, and now no one will ever have to. It is of course the inner body tilesets in all it's grossness. I was a little disappointed it didn't have any kind of liquid tiles that XP's defaults had, and of course I made those, both the XP's original yellow acid looking stuff, and a recolor of red blood stuff. I went through MANY many different variants of colors and tilesets trying to get this one to work with more colors, but it was just not working. Almost everything I tried would end up like a muggy mess, and well I didn't really want to spend THAT much more time messing with these. It IS kind of gross lol. I did recolor some of the demon world tiles to match it better since they all look like something that could work within it. I also added new pillers and more structures just to give some variants. The one major issue I have with this tileset is the water doesn't seem to animate too well. If someone REALLY wants me to change that, I will otherwise it's not really too big an issue.

posts.author: GoblinSpa
posts.body:
whtdragon said:
So I've been debating on doing this for awhile, and I'm still not quite sure how to organize this stuff out, so bare with me while I get things straightened out, but basically I've been working on tilesets for awhile in between animal sprites and other stuff, just kind of looming in the backdrop for when I felt like I had enough satisfying things to present.
I debated HEAVILY about putting all this in the
festivals and celebrations thread
but I decided against that because I feel like the focus of this is different from that, and I wanted to keep the festivals and celebrations thread it's own fun lil' thing to update.
I'm starting to notice a lot of creative folks working on plugins and sprites for a wide variety of things, and I figure I might as well post some things I feel like folks would logically need next. Some of this stuff is stuff I felt like NEEDED to be added because I'm not satisfied with the small amount of tiles to work with in the defaults, and I'm sure a lot of folks feel the same way. Like almost everything else I do, these are sticking closely to the MV default style, so a lot of it's gonna be recolors, but I will also try and cover some tile fixes and extra filler stuff that have been bugging me since MV was released (and I know some people have pointed them out too)  Also if I messed up on anything lemme know and I'll get 'em fixed. I've been working on a ton of this stuff lately, and yes I do have more, coming soon.
Terms:
As these are (mostly) edits of MV's sprites, you will need a legal copy of RPG maker MV
,
otherwise~~
Credit is appreciated, but not required.
They are free to use for commercial or non commercial.
You are free to use them in other RPG maker engines as long as you have MV license
You are free to edit, change, recolor, re-edit, remix, maim, mangle, add on, divide, and conquer to your heart's content. I don't even mind if you re-upload them elsewhere as it would only mean more people get access to them and that is A-OK in my books.
Tile Fixes:
First one I'd like to bring up that I fixed was the thing involving the lava tiles. (I'm sure someone else has done this too, but I can't find any threads specifically on the subject)
this is now a thing. Two animated waterfall (lavaflow rather) are required for this fix. one for top, one for bottom. You may find my full new Lava themed A1 tileset with the fix
here
or in the spoiler below assuming those still work properly.
Spoiler
Vines:
As there is currently only three types of vines, and vines are extremely common and used constantly in almost everyone's games, I have made a whole bunch of vine edits to break up the monotony
Spoiler
autotiles:
Sometimes things do not have auto-tiles that should, and that makes me a sad dragon. Like leaves. so I did that. More below.
expansions:
The "Demon World" tiles got a much needed expansion as well as some of the lesser used tiles. I still want to make more for it sometime, but hopefully what I do have now might be useful to someone. I am working on more.
side stairs:
gotten some requests to do some sideview staircases, so I took the small default ones from MV, and made them much larger, then added ones for grass, sand dirt, wood and stone. I know there's been several that's already done this, but I also included more of my recolored grasses and volcanic rock. I also included a "base" version so anyone can easily edit.
Spoiler
Volcano and cave tiles:
I know there's already a lot of resources for caverns and volcano themed tiles already but I did try to hit on the ones everyone seems to avoid. I also made several new more natural tones as well as a lot of varieties for mixed color sets. not only did I make a lot of new lava crack tiles for the various varieties of colors, but I've also got "cooled lava" where the lava has cooled down and is now black, and of course, I have also taken the liberty of adding some of the new lava flow animations with the fix, and I made a few "Abyss" type tiles.
Spoiler
massive wall/floor tiles. Note this is NOT a tileset. You will need to edit them into your own tilesets for use.
"Abyss" tiles and some extra stairs, wall holes. Note there are two lava autotiles. You will also need to edit these into your tilesets for use. I almost added crystals to the other walls too, but mmm I got kind of lazy /- w -; and it'd mean having to make new curved walls for everything and I'll do that maybe later.
This is a tileset B for new volcano/caves. I admit it's a bit messy. I've added a ton of new rock formations, and some new rock pillars, and I hope folks will get to use them/edit them~ There is a rock themed bed, chair/throne, counter and shelf with books because, well I wanted to make those. There is one issue with the stone tiles. I kind of made them blend in a bit TOO well with the ground tiles I have there, so if you do use them together I HIGHLY suggest you use more then one ground type to kind of patch it along so they stand out better, or edit their colors slightly so they stand out a bit better otherwise I'm sure plenty of people will enjoy them. also new flooded staircases o w o~
limestone/white submerged water caverns: will likely add more to this one later~
Seabed/underwater and ocean/beach tiles
:
this is the one I've been holding back the longest and it's been driving me crazy because I kept adding onto it, unsatisfied with it. I'm still not really happy with the set, but I'm hoping other folks are going to use it and play around with it and I know it's going to be massively useful. Includes many different colorful types of coral with some basic ocean colored tiles for ruins. Nothing too fancy there. The Ocean tiles are mimicing how XP handled some of the water tiles, I just really liked the tiles layering so I matched it as best I could. Added new ocean tiles!
Spoiler
a few basic seabed colored floors/walls with some extra stone pillars. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it.
full array of a B tileset, though you will likely end up having to edit it to fit your needs. (especially since there's some ground tiles not ment to be put in there oops :x ) still includes lots of coral and seaweed types! Also hope you like colors 'cause that's what we got.
Extra beach and ocean layers. It is a full A1 tilset. Not all of these really matches each other too well. Some of these would PROBABLY be better suited in the over world, but I figure for what it's worth it'll probably work for either over world and normal maps. added new overworld waterfall types because I can o w o~
new water tiles! Includes new variants of blue and a few more crazy/alien colors. These also have the seashore line without any sand, this is for better customization if anyone is interested in doing that. can be paired with some of ground and sand recolors.
Spiderwebs on stuff
:
currently only have spiderwebs for indoors. I am working on an outdoors version and eventually a cavern and forest version. This includes most major items having some kind of cob webbing on them, and I'm talking big gnarly spiderwebs. Includes MANY many wall, ceiling and floor webs, as well as most of the shelves, tables, cabinets, and chairs found in the defaults as well as a very basic web bridge. Not all the items from the default have been webbed, but I had an abandoned house in mind and figured most of the valuables and food would have been long gone. Outside spider web tiles are now included!
Spoiler
lil' preview of the webs in game. As you can see, the webbing is very gnarly, almost over the top. Perfect for spider monsters or cinematics.
This is a nearly full B tileset. The main issue with this one is it's not really easy to see the webbings so you might find yourself having to redo placements on them. Most webbing does have some kind of shadow though to make it a little easier to find. The reasoning for two different pianos and organs is I liked them both without as much webbing but the more I worked with the spider webs, the more they felt out of place from everything else so I made a second set that had more. Added more statues and boxes/crates
outside tiles full of spiderwebs o w o/~ this IS a nearly completed B tileset. I might add on to later down the line. It is ment to be an extension of the base outside tiles but could also be used with the indoor webbings for extended web use. Added new damaged windows too and an extended sign post.
Demon world tiles and other dark tiles
:
The tilesets that no one asked for lol when I opened up MV for the first time, and was looking around at the various tiles I was very much not happy that there was so few assets and items for other tiles that wasn't your typical fare of forests and villages. Here I have given the demon world tiles a whole new set of ground and wall types. Most of which are recolors. When I was working with the tileset, I had in mind an almost beautiful alien world where the various monsters originated from. Really there isn't as much here as I would probably like, but I did basically triple the amount of resources for the demon world, and hope it at least gives people insenstives to maybe take a second look at one of the more overlooked sets in RPG maker, and maybe make more content for it. The other tileset of course is the inner body one. I didn't make a lot of extras for it either, but I wasn't satisfied with what little was in the defaults, so I did some expanding on it and hopefully it's a bit more satisfying to use.
Spoiler
another look at the demon world tiles using more default items:
As you can see, this is a far larger expansion for something that should be in game content. I added a bunch of new ground covers in various recolors. It's not as expansive as the volcano tiles I made by any means, and is lacking a few things I would personally want, but it does have the basics. A decent ground tile, a stone pathway that could lead up to the castle for example, many new recolors for native plants, and some decent water tiles. As mentioned above I wanted this to be almost a beautiful strange world, the idea would be that it contrasts to the far more terrifying things found in the castle. Of course alternatively it could be used for scifi settings in alien planets. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
Here are some demon castle recolors and a few expansions. I came like, super close to making a whole new set of furniture just for this but went against it because I wasn't quite sure where to start for that. One of the things I wanted to do was expand on the eyeball floor coverings the default had. I twas the first thing I edited before deciding on going ahead and editing more of the demon world. The default was implying some kind of carpet that was leading up to the final boss. I made it more like a creepy normal floor tile with added eyeballs and even animated them. Yep~ the eyeballs are an A1 based tile and they animate. not very well mind you, A1 tiles are limited and the animation is a bit lame as a result but what can ya do~ Most of this is simple recolors, just adding more variety to the castles. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
I won't spend too much talking about this tileset, because I imagine of all the tilesets, this is the most likeliest one no one would ask more of, and now no one will ever have to. It is of course the inner body tilesets in all it's grossness. I was a little disappointed it didn't have any kind of liquid tiles that XP's defaults had, and of course I made those, both the XP's original yellow acid looking stuff, and a recolor of red blood stuff. I went through MANY many different variants of colors and tilesets trying to get this one to work with more colors, but it was just not working. Almost everything I tried would end up like a muggy mess, and well I didn't really want to spend THAT much more time messing with these. It IS kind of gross lol. I did recolor some of the demon world tiles to match it better since they all look like something that could work within it. I also added new pillers and more structures just to give some variants. The one major issue I have with this tileset is the water doesn't seem to animate too well. If someone REALLY wants me to change that, I will otherwise it's not really too big an issue.
new bodies extension. Some of these where made with the help of
albert-youkai
and
their tile edits.
some of these can also be used for alien worlds!
Winterized full tilesets:
I decided to take some of the default MV tilesets and make them winterized. So far, it is only the two modern (SF_outsideB and SF_outsideC) tiles and Outside B. The desert tiles have snow on them, and I DID go ahead and make snow versions of things that already had some snow types to them for a couple of reasons. 1, so the tiles would match to all the others I made, and 2. so there would be more variants. I do have some other tiles that I'll probably be making winter themed eventually!
Spoiler
outside B winterized tile:
SF_Outside B winterized
SF_outside C winterized
Graveyard and Catacombs:
I posted this one up a little while ago on twitter and on my profile. Since I have a lot of tiles to showcase I can show this one off too! It's pretty basic, the first half is for the outside/graveyard portion, and the right side is ment for some of the inner tiles, but it'll also work well with some outer components. I will be making some more dedicated inner tiles for this eventually, but for now this is pretty okay I think! It's loosely based off of The Zelda series for graveyards where the graves could hide hidden passageways. I also felt like there needed to be more varieties in headstones as well. The dead trees I don't know if they look okay or not, may have to rework those.
Spoiler
Grass,Dirt, flowerbeds, and leaves recolors
:
Because no one is recoloring this stuff, and I think we need to.
Not only am I covering recolored grasses and dirts, I'm also going to release a lot of flowerbed type stuff. This also includes auto-tiles for leaves and some other stuff I feel like needs to be done.
Spoiler
recolored grass with base dirt color!
MASSIVE image with recolored grass edges for new dirt types
more grass types of various colors
AND SINCE WE'RE RECOLORING GRASS AND DIRT
here's some simple more recolored dirt, sand and ground types:
additional/recolored leaves that are in fact auto tiles. This is the one that bothered me a lot because it should have been a thing right off the bat and it wasn't. Can be used for weddings for makeshift flower peddles too!
new leaves recolors!
Autotile Flowerbeds, I posted this earlier elsewhere but here's the official upload.
non auto-tiled flowerbeds in case you wanted something more customizable. Comes with dirt with boarders, more or less a sized up version of the default garden dirt but resized. Can also be used for trees and other plants. Also added extra dirt and some more boarders in case anyone wants those too u w o;
Buildings and inner items:
I told myself I wouldn't do any building based edits because there's already a ton of those available by lots of people, but I went ahead and did some editings myself. None of these are tilesets, they WILL need to be edited and added in as needed. Walls, Windows, Chairs and Rugs are here for now.
Now with extended shelves/store shelves, added kitchen items, TONS of colorful furniture, new furniture items, and new beds both side view and front, small and large and damaged in many colors!
Spoiler
Building/walls-- basically just expanded the color variants by a lot. Black and white variants are also available but moreso for chard/burnt colors. There are some darker toned colors for those that want a more natural/darker toned set. I also included a few multi-colored brick walls and some multi-colored rooftop tiles closer to the bottom u w o;~ yay colors! There's also some lighting tiles now for the windows.
massive castle recolors~
alternative wood rooftops with recolors with lighted windows--came really close to adding darker/night colors with them. maybe another time~
Even more rooftop recolors!
Window recolors are generally more natural wood colors. with a few painted ones. I didn't go too crazy with these in colors mostly because I wanted something that would pretty much go with anything else. I've seen lots of people do door recolors but I don't see too many recolors for the windows, so there ya go. There's a few darker toned browns at the bottom for darker tilesets.
Massive new rooftop extensions, there's so many I opted to give a
download instead right here
but here's a small sample:
requested lighting for windows, both for the defaults and all my recolors~ these are NOT a full tileset, you will need to edit them into your tiles
modern windows getting lighting:
Even MORE window lighting! this time for the castle tiles, tents, and other window types:
General purpose lighting for a variety of things.
I posted an early preview of these chairs up a week ago but I've since added more colors. I didn't like the original royal chair in the default tilesets so I've decided to make smaller varients to it. You can see the size difference up in the upper left corner. I decided to leave a lot of my edited trimmings so anyone can make more color variants if they so wish because I realize that that there could potentially be thousands of combinations for everyone, and I just wanted to make it as easy and painless as possible. I also decided to make other chair types because sometimes you just don't need a super fancy embellished chair. looking back on it I probably should make side and back versions of the other chairs because they do look like fancy dinning seats at least, but I might do that later down the line if there's enough interest for them.
I made these rug recolors awhile ago and posted them up on twitter, but I thought I'd post them up once I started getting into doing housing type tiles, and here we are. There are some edited rugs too, and I hope you enjoy u w u/
new modern rug/floor tiles:
made these awhile back --forgot to upload them! here they are!
modern wall tiles:
another set of tiles I didn't upload sooner. Here they are!
Nearly complete Tileset for new store shelves to extend shops, includes new variants for bakery, new baked goods, bottles on shelves, more kitchen shelves for restaurants or a massive kitchen, larger extended stove expanded kitchen counter for new shapes. New toy shop, flower shop, medicine shop, and jewelry store items, and expandable bookshelves for libraries or large rooms!
Massive recolors of various furniture with some smaller added furniture bits to help fill out rooms more. Comes in a variety of colors. I tried making it so everything would match with each other so you can color coordinate things better and they can at least look like they are somewhat matching with each other. I might as well make a new catagory since this will be a thing soon! Will be featuring all sorts of dungeon based tiles hopefully. The Treasure Room is currently available.

The second part, on the upper right side is cavern tiles and the third below that is gold walls with some matching furniture.

So I've been debating on doing this for awhile, and I'm still not quite sure how to organize this stuff out, so bare with me while I get things straightened out, but basically I've been working on tilesets for awhile in between animal sprites and other stuff, just kind of looming in the backdrop for when I felt like I had enough satisfying things to present.

festivals and celebrations thread

I'm starting to notice a lot of creative folks working on plugins and sprites for a wide variety of things, and I figure I might as well post some things I feel like folks would logically need next. Some of this stuff is stuff I felt like NEEDED to be added because I'm not satisfied with the small amount of tiles to work with in the defaults, and I'm sure a lot of folks feel the same way. Like almost everything else I do, these are sticking closely to the MV default style, so a lot of it's gonna be recolors, but I will also try and cover some tile fixes and extra filler stuff that have been bugging me since MV was released (and I know some people have pointed them out too)  Also if I messed up on anything lemme know and I'll get 'em fixed. I've been working on a ton of this stuff lately, and yes I do have more, coming soon.
Terms:
As these are (mostly) edits of MV's sprites, you will need a legal copy of RPG maker MV
,
otherwise~~
Credit is appreciated, but not required.
They are free to use for commercial or non commercial.
You are free to use them in other RPG maker engines as long as you have MV license
You are free to edit, change, recolor, re-edit, remix, maim, mangle, add on, divide, and conquer to your heart's content. I don't even mind if you re-upload them elsewhere as it would only mean more people get access to them and that is A-OK in my books.
Tile Fixes:
First one I'd like to bring up that I fixed was the thing involving the lava tiles. (I'm sure someone else has done this too, but I can't find any threads specifically on the subject)
this is now a thing. Two animated waterfall (lavaflow rather) are required for this fix. one for top, one for bottom. You may find my full new Lava themed A1 tileset with the fix
here

Spoiler
autotiles:
Sometimes things do not have auto-tiles that should, and that makes me a sad dragon. Like leaves. so I did that. More below.
expansions:
The "Demon World" tiles got a much needed expansion as well as some of the lesser used tiles. I still want to make more for it sometime, but hopefully what I do have now might be useful to someone. I am working on more.
side stairs:
gotten some requests to do some sideview staircases, so I took the small default ones from MV, and made them much larger, then added ones for grass, sand dirt, wood and stone. I know there's been several that's already done this, but I also included more of my recolored grasses and volcanic rock. I also included a "base" version so anyone can easily edit.
Spoiler
Volcano and cave tiles:
I know there's already a lot of resources for caverns and volcano themed tiles already but I did try to hit on the ones everyone seems to avoid. I also made several new more natural tones as well as a lot of varieties for mixed color sets. not only did I make a lot of new lava crack tiles for the various varieties of colors, but I've also got "cooled lava" where the lava has cooled down and is now black, and of course, I have also taken the liberty of adding some of the new lava flow animations with the fix, and I made a few "Abyss" type tiles.
Spoiler

"Abyss" tiles and some extra stairs, wall holes. Note there are two lava autotiles. You will also need to edit these into your tilesets for use. I almost added crystals to the other walls too, but mmm I got kind of lazy /- w -; and it'd mean having to make new curved walls for everything and I'll do that maybe later.
This is a tileset B for new volcano/caves. I admit it's a bit messy. I've added a ton of new rock formations, and some new rock pillars, and I hope folks will get to use them/edit them~ There is a rock themed bed, chair/throne, counter and shelf with books because, well I wanted to make those. There is one issue with the stone tiles. I kind of made them blend in a bit TOO well with the ground tiles I have there, so if you do use them together I HIGHLY suggest you use more then one ground type to kind of patch it along so they stand out better, or edit their colors slightly so they stand out a bit better otherwise I'm sure plenty of people will enjoy them. also new flooded staircases o w o~

Just an assortment of different kinds of statues

Includes many different colorful types of coral with some basic ocean colored tiles for ruins. Nothing too fancy there. The Ocean tiles are mimicing how XP handled some of the water tiles, I just really liked the tiles layering so I matched it as best I could. Added new ocean tiles!
Spoiler

full array of a B tileset, though you will likely end up having to edit it to fit your needs. (especially since there's some ground tiles not ment to be put in there oops :x ) still includes lots of coral and seaweed types! Also hope you like colors 'cause that's what we got.

Spiderwebs on stuff

currently only have spiderwebs for indoors. I am working on an outdoors version and eventually a cavern and forest version. This includes most major items having some kind of cob webbing on them, and I'm talking big gnarly spiderwebs. Includes MANY many wall, ceiling and floor webs, as well as most of the shelves, tables, cabinets, and chairs found in the defaults as well as a very basic web bridge. Not all the items from the default have been webbed, but I had an abandoned house in mind and figured most of the valuables and food would have been long gone. Outside spider web tiles are now included!
Spoiler
lil' preview of the webs in game. As you can see, the webbing is very gnarly, almost over the top. Perfect for spider monsters or cinematics.

Most webbing does have some kind of shadow though to make it a little easier to find. outside tiles full of spiderwebs o w o/~ this IS a nearly completed B tileset. I might add on to later down the line. It is ment to be an extension of the base outside tiles but could also be used with the indoor webbings for extended web use. Added new damaged windows too and an extended sign post.
Demon world tiles and other dark tiles

The tilesets that no one asked for lol when I opened up MV for the first time, and was looking around at the various tiles I was very much not happy that there was so few assets and items for other tiles that wasn't your typical fare of forests and villages. Here I have given the demon world tiles a whole new set of ground and wall types. Most of which are recolors. When I was working with the tileset, I had in mind an almost beautiful alien world where the various monsters originated from. Really there isn't as much here as I would probably like, but I did basically triple the amount of resources for the demon world, and hope it at least gives people insenstives to maybe take a second look at one of the more overlooked sets in RPG maker, and maybe make more content for it. The other tileset of course is the inner body one. I didn't make a lot of extras for it either, but I wasn't satisfied with what little was in the defaults, so I did some expanding on it and hopefully it's a bit more satisfying to use.
Spoiler
another look at the demon world tiles using more default items:
As you can see, this is a far larger expansion for something that should be in game content. I added a bunch of new ground covers in various recolors. It's not as expansive as the volcano tiles I made by any means, and is lacking a few things I would personally want, but it does have the basics. A decent ground tile, a stone pathway that could lead up to the castle for example, many new recolors for native plants, and some decent water tiles. As mentioned above I wanted this to be almost a beautiful strange world, the idea would be that it contrasts to the far more terrifying things found in the castle. Of course alternatively it could be used for scifi settings in alien planets. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
Here are some demon castle recolors and a few expansions. I came like, super close to making a whole new set of furniture just for this but went against it because I wasn't quite sure where to start for that. One of the things I wanted to do was expand on the eyeball floor coverings the default had. I twas the first thing I edited before deciding on going ahead and editing more of the demon world. The default was implying some kind of carpet that was leading up to the final boss. I made it more like a creepy normal floor tile with added eyeballs and even animated them. Yep~ the eyeballs are an A1 based tile and they animate. not very well mind you, A1 tiles are limited and the animation is a bit lame as a result but what can ya do~ Most of this is simple recolors, just adding more variety to the castles. This is NOT a tileset, you will need to edit it for your own purposes.
I won't spend too much talking about this tileset, because I imagine of all the tilesets, this is the most likeliest one no one would ask more of, and now no one will ever have to. It is of course the inner body tilesets in all it's grossness. I was a little disappointed it didn't have any kind of liquid tiles that XP's defaults had, and of course I made those, both the XP's original yellow acid looking stuff, and a recolor of red blood stuff. I went through MANY many different variants of colors and tilesets trying to get this one to work with more colors, but it was just not working. Almost everything I tried would end up like a muggy mess, and well I didn't really want to spend THAT much more time messing with these. It IS kind of gross lol. I did recolor some of the demon world tiles to match it better since they all look like something that could work within it. I also added new pillers and more structures just to give some variants. The one major issue I have with this tileset is the water doesn't seem to animate too well. If someone REALLY wants me to change that, I will otherwise it's not really too big an issue.
